decision: Retain v482 as the exact-current D4 contact-water technical evidence. The bounded shoulder is derived from live water and D4 deformation, adds one non-colliding draw call only during wet contact, and fades into the sampled free surface at every edge. The analytic breakup and volumetric non-directional translucency remove the visibly separate v469 patch and pass the exact-current 60-second Shipping performance budget. The broader water is still too calm, the spray remains card-like, and the generated boulder, parametric raft, crew, poses, equipment integration, terrain seam, and environment remain visibly synthetic. This frame is rejected for photoreal, marketing, store, press, and human art approval.
